Reyansh Salvi

My understanding is that Hebert doesn't have the legal authority (and the filing never makes clear) to Suspend delivery under the Grain Supply Agreement (he probably doesn't have the political support for this either).

AgriCo, however, could support this in its filing as a method to help move the Warehouse Issue forward.

FYI.  Any thoughts Dakshesh & Co.? Is release from contracts an "increase supply" option?  My fear is that Farmers get released and then Maharashtra's "police state" mentality kicks in, enacting legislation, etc. to ensure that the grains from the Farmers stay in Maharashtra.

Best,
Reyansh
